questions.help: Journeys and defensive and efficient driving     8 Efficient drivingEconomic and efficient driving means employing a system that saves fuel, reduces pollution and eliminates any unnecessary expense whilst not compromising safety.(Página 275 del manual 'Learning to drive')Journeys and defensive and efficient driving       9 Efficient driving techniques   9.3 Travelling speedTherefore, it is advisable to moderate the speed and keep it as consistent as possible, adapting it to the road and traffic conditions. The continuous variation of speed will increase fuel consumption, and in heavy traffic, driver fatigue will occur.It is advisable to drive evenly, this means avoid hard braking, harsh acceleration and unnecessary gear changes, maintain a consistent speed for as long as possible. Use the techniques of preventive driving: drive always with anticipation and awareness, maintain an adequate safety distance and keep the field of vision as broad as possible, so as to be able see 2 or 3 vehicles in front. Unnecessary stopping and starting and speed variations caused by the lack of foresight and anticipation increase consumption.(Página 277 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help: Journeys and defensive and efficient driving   10 Factors affecting consumption 10.1 Air resistanceThe majority of fuel consumed is used to overcome air (wind) resistance that acts against the advancing vehicle.This means that anything that increases or changes the aerodynamics lines (the design) of a vehicle has a greater impact on consumption.This is why external accessories, (roof racks, flaps and deflectors, etc.) increase the resistance of the vehicle and, therefore, increase fuel consumption. It is not advisable to leave the roof rack on the vehicle when it is empty and not being used. It is preferable to carry the load in the boot, whenever possible and not on the roof rack.(Página 277 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help: Journeys and defensive and efficient driving     10 Factors affecting consumption  10.2 Vehicle maintenanceThe periodic fine-tuning of the automobile dramatically affects fuel savings.A vehicle should be maintained in perfect condition. This means:The ignition system: Should be correctly tuned with the spark plugs set according to the manufacturer’ guide.The fuel system: The periodic replacement of the air filter is important, as the inability of the air to flow correctly through effects the mixture of fuel that is fed to the engine, the richer the mixture the more fuel is consumed.(Página 277 del manual 'Learning to drive')Journeys and defensive and efficient driving       10 Factors affecting consumption   10.2 Vehicle maintenanceThe periodic fine-tuning of the automobile dramatically affects fuel savings.A vehicle should be maintained in perfect condition. This means:The cooling and lubrication systems.The inflation pressure of the tyres. Ensuring that the tyres are correctly inflated saves fuel and avoids premature and unnecessary wearing of the tyres.(Página 277 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help: Journeys and defensive and efficient driving       10 Factors affecting consumption   10.3 Travelling on urban and interurban routesOn city roads, consumption is higher than on intercity roads, despite the lower speeds. This is due to traffic fluctuations with frequent stops, the use of low gears, traffic jams (if you are stopped for a long period, you should switch off the engine to save fuel), and because the engine is not operating in optimum conditions.(Página 278 del manual 'Learning to drive')

Low emission zones shall be signposted using vertical sign R-120, which prohibits access to vehicles based ontheir environmental badge or other established environmental criteria.The specific conditions shall be indicated on a supplementary panel or on a signboard accompanying the main sign.   (Página 279 del manual 'Learning to drive')
